description: This file defines the DeviceHandler class, which manages device status, info, permissions, and health data on an Android device. It gathers system information such as battery, thermal, storage, network, memory, and power states, and provides methods to retrieve these details in JSON format.

classes.name: DeviceHandler
classes.description: A class that handles querying various device states, such as battery, storage, network, and permissions, and returns the data as JSON strings encapsulated in GatewaySession.InvokeResult objects.

inner_classes.name: BatterySnapshot
inner_classes.description: A data class representing a snapshot of battery information, including status, plugged state, level fraction, and temperature.

methods.name: handleDeviceStatus
methods.description: Returns a GatewaySession.InvokeResult containing the current device status, including battery, thermal, storage, and network information.

methods.name: handleDeviceInfo
methods.description: Returns a GatewaySession.InvokeResult with static device information such as model, manufacturer, OS version, app version, and locale.

methods.name: handleDevicePermissions
methods.description: Returns a GatewaySession.InvokeResult with the current permission statuses for various features like camera, microphone, location, SMS, notifications, photos, contacts, calendar, call log, and motion sensors.

methods.name: handleDeviceHealth
methods.description: Returns a GatewaySession.InvokeResult with system health metrics such as memory pressure, RAM usage, battery state, and power mode statuses.

methods.name: statusPayloadJson
methods.description: Constructs a JSON string containing battery, thermal, storage, and network status details.

methods.name: infoPayloadJson
methods.description: Constructs a JSON string with static device information: model, manufacturer, OS version, app version, and locale.

methods.name: permissionsPayloadJson
methods.description: Constructs a JSON string detailing the app's permissions status and capabilities for various device features.

methods.name: healthPayloadJson
methods.description: Constructs a JSON string with system health data including memory pressure, battery info, and power modes.

methods.name: readBatterySnapshot
methods.description: Collects current battery information by registering a receiver for battery change intents.

methods.name: batteryLevelFraction
methods.description: Calculates the battery level as a fraction from a battery intent.

methods.name: mapBatteryState
methods.description: Maps battery status integer codes to descriptive string states.

methods.name: mapChargingType
methods.description: Maps battery plugged states to descriptive strings indicating power source type.

methods.name: mapThermalState
methods.description: Maps thermal status codes to severity descriptions like 'nominal', 'fair', 'serious', 'critical'.

methods.name: mapNetworkStatus
methods.description: Maps NetworkCapabilities to human-readable network status states.

methods.name: permissionStateJson
methods.description: Creates a JSON object representing the permission status and promptability.

methods.name: hasPermission
methods.description: Checks whether the app has a specific permission granted.

methods.name: mapMemoryPressure
methods.description: Determines memory pressure level based on total and available memory.

methods.name: networkInterfacesJson
methods.description: Creates a JSON array of network interface types based on NetworkCapabilities transports.
